title: Farewell Address to the Nation: The Military-Industrial Complex Warning
publisher_or_archive: White House / National Archives and Records Administration (Public Papers of the Presidents)
summary: Historic presidential valedictory address delivered on January 17, 1961, by former Supreme Allied Commander and US President Dwight D. Eisenhower, issuing an explicit warning to the American public against the acquisition of unwarranted influence, whether sought or unsought, by the military-industrial complex, and alerting citizens to the danger that public policy could become the captive of a scientific-technological elite.
